title: Simcoe Irrigating Cannula 21 G, Medical Grade, Stainless Steel
description: The Simcoe Irrigation 21G Aspiration Cannula is a precision-engineered medical device designed for professional medical use. This high-quality cannula features a durable clear tubing with secure metal connectors at both ends, ensuring reliable fluid aspiration during medical procedures. The 21-gauge specification offers optimal flow control while maintaining minimal invasiveness. The medical-grade construction meets rigorous quality standards for healthcare applications. The flexible, transparent tubing allows for clear visibility of fluid flow, while the robust metal fittings provide secure connections to standard medical equipment. This aspiration cannula is specifically designed for irrigation procedures, offering consistent performance and reliable fluid management. The device comes individually packaged to maintain sterility until use.
